modmenu.summaryTranslation.herzium: Uncapped rendering, low-latency input, and high-refresh visuals.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.herzium: Removes active-window VSync and internal FPS limits, reduces mouse and hotbar latency, and eliminates safe loading delays.
herzium.config.title: Herzium
herzium.config.subtitle: Coming soon: more configurations
herzium.option.immediate_hotbar_selectio: Selects slots 1-9 on the input event; the latest received key wins. Disable it to restore vanilla tick timing.
herzium.loading.title: HERZIUM
herzium.loading.subtitle: Loading at full speed
herzium.loading.tip.0: No VSync. No waiting. Just frames.
herzium.loading.tip.1: Herzium keeps your HUD moving at your refresh rate.
herzium.loading.tip.2: Loading pixels at an unreasonable speed...
herzium.loading.tip.3: Your FPS cap has left the game.
herzium.loading.tip.4: Tip: your display refresh rate matters too.
herzium.loading.tip.5: Fast hands, smooth HUD, vanilla mechanics.
herzium.loading.tip.7: Mining the loading screen. Almost there.
herzium.loading.tip.9: Resource packs still require real work. Magic has limits.
herzium.loading.tip.10: High refresh rates deserve high-frequency visuals.
herzium.loading.tip.11: Removing decorative delays one millisecond at a time.
herzium.warning.title: HERZIUM WARNING
herzium.warning.message: Herzium removes active-window frame-rate limits and prioritizes minimum input latency. An unfocused window is protected at 10 FPS. Depending on your hardware, drivers, settings, and other mods, it may cause instability, FPS drops, uneven frame times, high GPU or CPU usage, extra heat, or increased power consumption. Use it at your own risk.
herzium.warning.quote: Speed is essential, but control turns it into performance.
